evidence-check.scope: Native HTML fields and dated explicit decisions. All 40 directory descriptions match the saved API; no new catalog specification is imported.

limitations: This batch checks 40 further saved listing URLs (rows 151-190); it does not establish completeness of the live competitor inventory. The source inventory remains dated November 1, 2026.
All 40 normalized detail descriptions match the saved raw API descriptions. This confirms source consistency, not independent truth of their claims.
All 40 decisions are recorded: 28 consistent with primary scope, 7 directory conflicts, and 5 primary follow-ups required.
Robot-Rentals.com states that it has ceased all operations; the directory still lists its Furo-D event-rental offer as available. Recorded as a provider-status conflict.

DUSt3R is NAVER LABS 3D-reconstruction software, not a cleaning robot. FlightLine is uAvionix ADS-B surveillance data, not an Iris airframe. Firejet is the Kratos MQM-178 target drone used by Shield AI in autonomy trials, not a Shield-manufactured aircraft.

Eve is branded by Bots-4-Events as a robot-dog rental while the provider is Exoskeleton Report, a media outlet; the exoskeleton description does not match the branded offer. The provider site returned HTTP 403.
ECOVACS "Global No.1 Home Robotics Brand" and DENSO "Global Supplier of Advanced Robotics Technology" are marketing slogans, not robot models. No ranking or leadership claim is adopted.
Event Robot rents Unitree GO2 with legs and with wheels as event entertainment; these are rental configurations, not separate models manufactured by the provider.
Dürr, FarmWise, Formant and Gaussian Robotics are company headings or software offerings without a named robot model; no individual catalog identity is imported.

Three primary sources were unusable: Rainbow Robotics failed with a TLS error, Exoskeleton Report returned HTTP 403, and Iris Automation returned HTTP 403. Their directory claims therefore remain without fresh primary verification.
Directory descriptions and manufacturer claims do not establish exclusive USPs, independent performance, current availability, delivered deployments or market leadership.
Catalog CSVs, primary product highlights, specification reviews and existing identity decisions remain byte-identical. No front-end build or browser test is required for this batch.
